ITEM 1 | Large wedge-shaped slice with a thick, bready golden-brown crust edge; top covered in melted white cheese with irregular orange-red tomato-sauce patches and browned spots; cheese is stretchy-looking and glossy, sauce is slightly oily; occupies roughly 12 cm by 8 cm at lower right of plate, about 1.5 cm thick | 150

ITEM 2 | Two rolled or folded pieces of golden-brown, flaky-looking pastry, lightly browned with some darker crisp edges; interior shows pale tan filling with small specks of green herb and a slightly moist look; sits at upper right of plate, roughly 9 cm by 4 cm total, about 2.5 cm tall | 70

ITEM 3 | Small crumbs and bits of orange-red sauce or cooked filling scattered at upper right edge of plate, slightly glossy and moist, irregular shapes about 1 to 2 cm | 8
